_comment: Priority table for culture validation checks. Each check id may be:
_comment2: "required"  - missing data makes the culture fail the validation (exit code 1)
_comment3: "optional"  - missing data is only a warning; the culture still 'works'
_comment6: A check id can also be an object: {"priority": "optional", "files": ["education_character_templates.xml"]}
_comment7: where 'files' restricts which data files that check inspects (matched by basename / glob).
_comment8: File patterns below tell the indexer which xml files to read and which dirs to skip.

equipment_templates_categories._comment: Checks per-culture equipment rosters (EquipmentCategories flags) required by DefaultEquipmentSelectionModel. Applies to main cultures only. Scans all data folders.
